title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
author: Stephen Chbosky
summary: In letters to an unnamed friend, a shy freshman describes his first year of high school, adopted by two older students who bring him into their circle of music, parties and friendship.
readIf: you want a tender, honest coming-of-age story told in a young, plain voice.
skipIf: you want to avoid stories involving abuse and mental illness.

pairings.reason: Another sensitive teenage story about belonging, loss and finding a group.
The older classic of a sensitive teen narrator who sees through the adult world.
A warm, funny romance with the same 1980s-and-1990s mixtape nostalgia.
